summary: A resident brings the committee two totals for the same week of home care.
realLife: Alene Shaheed told senators that Florida authorized 35 hours of weekly help while she could find an aide for only 20.
gates: A service authorization and a staffing record cover the same person and week.
inGame: needs: authorized and staffed hours for the same week.

turns.what: A relief aide fills the remaining hours.
turns.pulledBy: The provider has a worker available for the uncovered shifts.
turns.writesBack: Delivered hours reach the authorized total.

turns.what: An aide takes one open shift.
turns.pulledBy: One vacancy fits the aide’s availability.
turns.writesBack: Delivered hours rise while the authorization stays the same.
